about: Steps the TypeScript MarkDirector (src/packages/hud/src/bots/mark-director.ts) took over scripted snapshots, with Date.now pinned to each step's now: what it was given (a snapshot to read, the keys looked at, or an advance), the wire it published after, and its nextChange. Times are UTC seconds; snapshots carry only what the director reads.
